rices.name: Lofi
rices.author: Ryoku Team
rices.blurb: After-hours pixel art. Warm, muted, and square: zero rounding across windows, the frame edge, the bar and the chrome, no glass, a structured bar, and a warm amber palette.

rices.name: Pastel
rices.author: Ryoku Team
rices.blurb: Soft, bright, and round to the edge: high rounding across windows, the frame edge, the bar and the chrome, glassy blur, a gentle glow, and a cotton-candy palette.

rices.name: Red Life
rices.author: one
rices.blurb: Deep red and earthy tones with wobbly windows, animated borders, and a cozy sidebar. Features Vimix cursor, dynamic cursors, and glass blur.
